CR-Type Stop Ring for Holes (CRTW)

A stop ring that secures itself by having multiple star-shaped prongs (6–8) bite into the inner wall of a hole. It is similar to a push nut (RPN), but has more prongs arranged radially, distributing the load more evenly. It can be installed directly without any groove machining. The spec symbol is written as CRTW.
